The failure came from comparing `CobDecimal` values with `<`, which `CobDecimal` does not support. All comparisons now use the `Decimal` from `FieldRef.value`.

```python
from decimal import Decimal

from cobol_equiv.runtime import (
    Storage, Group, Num, Alnum, Filler, move, add, subtract, compute, dec,
    initialize, display_line, All,
)
from cobol_equiv.runtime.files import LineSequentialReader


def main(stdin: bytes, input_files: dict[str, bytes]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes]]:
    out = bytearray()

    tran = Storage("TRAN-REC", [
        Num("TR-PART", "9(4)"),
        Alnum("TR-CODE", "X"),
        Num("TR-QTY", "9(3)"),
    ])

    ws = Storage("WS", [
        Alnum("WS-EOF", "X", value="N"),
        Group("PART-DATA", [
            Filler("X(15)", "1010BOLT   0500"),
            Filler("X(15)", "1020NUT    0300"),
            Filler("X(15)", "1110WASHER 0050"),
            Filler("X(15)", "2005GEAR   0010"),
            Filler("X(15)", "2500SHAFT  0000"),
            Filler("X(15)", "3300SPRING 0120"),
            Filler("X(15)", "4001PULLEY 0007"),
            Filler("X(15)", "7777BELT   0999"),
        ]),
        Group("PART-TABLE", [
            Group("PT-ENTRY", [
                Num("PT-PART", "9(4)"),
                Alnum("PT-NAME", "X(7)"),
                Num("PT-ONHAND", "9(4)"),
            ], occurs=8),
        ], redefines="PART-DATA"),
        Group("WS-SUMMARY", [
            Group("SM-COUNTS", [
                Num("SM-RECEIPTS", "9(3)"),
                Num("SM-ISSUES", "9(3)"),
                Num("SM-ADJUSTS", "9(3)"),
                Num("SM-ERRORS", "9(3)"),
            ]),
            Group("SM-QTY", [
                Num("SM-IN", "9(6)"),
                Num("SM-OUT", "9(6)"),
                Num("SM-SHORT", "9(6)"),
            ]),
            Alnum("SM-LAST-PART", "X(4)"),
        ]),
        Alnum("WS-STATUS", "X"),
        Num("WS-SHORT", "9(3)"),
    ])

    def onhand(i):
        return ws.f("PT-ONHAND", i)

    move(All("X"), ws["WS-SUMMARY"])
    initialize(ws["WS-SUMMARY"])

    reader = LineSequentialReader(input_files.get("TRANS.DAT", b""), 8)

    def issue_stock(px):
        if tran["TR-QTY"].value > onhand(px).value:
            compute(ws["WS-SHORT"], dec(tran["TR-QTY"]) - dec(onhand(px)))
            add(ws["WS-SHORT"], ws["SM-SHORT"])
            add(onhand(px), ws["SM-OUT"])
            move(0, onhand(px))
            out.extend(display_line("SHORT ", tran["TR-PART"], " ", ws["WS-SHORT"]))
        else:
            subtract(tran["TR-QTY"], onhand(px))
            add(tran["TR-QTY"], ws["SM-OUT"])

    def apply_tran():
        px = None
        lo, hi = 1, 8
        key = tran["TR-PART"].value
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            k = ws.f("PT-PART", mid).value
            if k == key:
                px = mid
                break
            if k < key:
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        if px is None:
            add(1, ws["SM-ERRORS"])
            out.extend(display_line("UNKNOWN PART ", tran["TR-PART"]))
            return
        move(tran["TR-PART"], ws["SM-LAST-PART"])
        code = tran["TR-CODE"].raw
        if code == b"R":
            add(1, ws["SM-RECEIPTS"])
            add(tran["TR-QTY"], [onhand(px), ws["SM-IN"]])
            q = tran["TR-QTY"].value
            if Decimal(500) <= q <= Decimal(999):
                out.extend(display_line("BULK RECEIPT ", tran["TR-PART"], " ", tran["TR-QTY"]))
        elif code == b"I":
            add(1, ws["SM-ISSUES"])
            issue_stock(px)
        elif code in (b"+", b"-"):
            add(1, ws["SM-ADJUSTS"])
            if code == b"+":
                add(tran["TR-QTY"], onhand(px))
            else:
                if tran["TR-QTY"].value > onhand(px).value:
                    move(0, onhand(px))
                else:
                    subtract(tran["TR-QTY"], onhand(px))
        else:
            add(1, ws["SM-ERRORS"])
            out.extend(display_line("BAD CODE ", tran["TR-PART"], " [", tran["TR-CODE"], "]"))

    while True:
        r = reader.read(tran.record())
        if r is None:
            break
        apply_tran()

    for px in range(1, 9):
        v = onhand(px).value
        if v == 0:
            move("E", ws["WS-STATUS"])
        elif v < 20:
            move("L", ws["WS-STATUS"])
        else:
            move("O", ws["WS-STATUS"])
        out.extend(display_line(ws.f("PT-PART", px), " ", ws.f("PT-NAME", px), " ",
                                onhand(px), " ", ws["WS-STATUS"]))
    out.extend(display_line("R ", ws["SM-RECEIPTS"], " I ", ws["SM-ISSUES"],
                            " A ", ws["SM-ADJUSTS"], " E ", ws["SM-ERRORS"]))
    out.extend(display_line("IN ", ws["SM-IN"], " OUT ", ws["SM-OUT"],
                            " SHORT ", ws["SM-SHORT"], " LAST [", ws["SM-LAST-PART"], "]"))
    return bytes(out), {}
```
